title: Add NOTAMs as third data source
description: Integrate NOTAM (Notice to Airmen) data as a third data source alongside DOF and Part 77. Search NOTAMs by geographic location, filter for class=obstruction and condition contains CRANE, and display consistently with existing data points. Daily updates covering continental USA (48 states + DC).
design: Approach: Daily batch update (1x/day) via GitHub Actions. Query NOTAM Search API from notams.aim.faa.gov using geographic grid search. Filter: class=obstruction, condition contains CRANE, current date within start/end range. Save to public/data/notams.csv matching DOF/Part77 format. Display in frontend with distinct icon/color.
acceptance_criteria:
- NOTAM data fetched daily via GitHub Actions
- Data filtered for obstruction class + CRANE keyword + active dates  
- CSV file created at public/data/notams.csv
- NOTAMs displayed on map with distinct icon/color
- Data source filter allows toggling NOTAM visibility
- Table shows NOTAM records with source badge
- No performance degradation (load time < 5s)

title: Test NOTAM API access from Python
description: Create scripts/test_notam_api.py to verify programmatic API access. Test with Phoenix area coordinates.
design:
## API ENDPOINT

URL: https://notams.aim.faa.gov/notamSearch/search
Method: POST
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Response: JSON
reCAPTCHA: NOT REQUIRED (works with empty token!)

## COORDINATE FORMAT

API uses DMS (Degrees, Minutes, Seconds), not decimal:
- latDegrees=33, latMinutes=26, latSeconds=54, latitudeDirection=N
- longDegrees=112, longMinutes=4, longSeconds=26, longitudeDirection=W
- radius in nautical miles

## RESPONSE STRUCTURE

JSON with 'notamList' array containing NOTAM objects:
- totalNotamCount: 159 (Phoenix test)
- notamList: Array of NOTAMs
- Each NOTAM has: notamNumber, status, startDate, endDate, traditionalMessage, mapPointer

## KEY FIELDS

- mapPointer: "POINT(lon lat)" in WGS84 decimal (use this!)
- traditionalMessage: Search for 'CRANE' keyword here
- plainLanguageMessage: Also search for 'CRANE'
- startDate/endDate: Validity period (MM/DD/YYYY HHmm or PERM)
- status: Active/Cancelled/Expired
- notamNumber: Unique ID like "5/9652"
- ASN references in message match DOF/Part77 format!

## CRANE DETECTION

Phoenix test found 7 crane NOTAMs including:
'TEMPORARY CRANE 1403 MSL 5949FT SW OF RWY 7L (2023-AWP-10023-OE)'

Search for: CRANE, MOBILE CRANE, TOWER CRANE, CONSTRUCTION

## COVERAGE STRATEGY

- Grid of ~1500 points at 100 NM spacing with 100 NM radius
- Deduplicate by notamNumber
- 1-2 sec delay between requests
- Total runtime: 30-50 min per update
acceptance_criteria: Script successfully fetches NOTAM data and prints JSON response
notes:

Key Findings:

Critical Fields:

- status: Active/Cancelled/Expired
